claim_ceiling: COMPLEMENTARY ROLE CHARACTERIZED at max available scale (144k/22yr). Dense embeddings NECESSARY and SUFFICIENT for: (1) Citation Heritage Recovery AUC 0.79-0.85 > TF-IDF 0.71-0.74, minimal scale ~130k (21yr); (2) Section Cross-lingual Alignment hierarchy Sachverhalt > Dispositiv > Erwaegungen at 1K sample, center projection improves 16-38%, full corpus BLOCKED; (3) Linear Hybrid Complement PASS adversarial at 19yr+ with w=0.3-0.4, adds cross-lingual benefit but BELOW TF-IDF on JP (0.66-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79). TF-IDF citation hybrids = PRIMARY (JP 0.78); Dense = COMPLEMENTARY. Two-mode tradeoff FUNDAMENTAL. No further same-question cycles justified.
evidence_summary: All 8 critical evidence files independently verified: (1) Citation heritage AUC 0.79-0.85 at 21-22yr scale (137k-144k decisions) with 100-344 positive pairs, exceeding TF-IDF citation baseline (0.71-0.74); (2) Section cross-lingual hierarchy confirmed at 1K sample: Sachverhalt cp64 gap=0.187, Dispositiv gap=0.397, Erwaegungen gap=0.452, center projection reduces gaps 16-38%; (3) Linear hybrid weight sweeps at 19yr (122k) and 22yr (144k) show optimal w=0.3→0.4 shift, both PASS adversarial gates but JP remains 0.11-0.12 below TF-IDF baseline; (4) Two-mode tradeoff reproduced across all scales: TF-IDF (LangDom~0.48, JP~0.78, CiteIndep~14%), Semantic (LangDom~0.83-0.98, JP~0.05-0.43, CiteIndep~37%), Hybrids intermediate; (5) v8 holdout validation: all 4 zero-shot hybrids PASS, leakage minimal (JP -0.015 to -0.020); (6) Legal TF-IDF from bge_ corpus (6k published decisions) FAILS adversarial suite (6-8/14 PASS) and citation heritage (AUC~0.5) — corpus mismatch diagnosed; (7) TF-IDF 174k formal suite: 8/8 PASS, best cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 JP=0.7345; (8) Dense blockers unchanged: 144k/174k (83%), years 2022-2026 missing, no bge_/bger_ mapping, no parquet, section extraction not run. All negative results honestly reported. No benchmark gaming, leakage, or prettiness-as-quality detected.
